ui_bugs.component: LotDetailPage main image container (DOM height overflow)
ui_bugs.issue:
MINOR — The element has DOM bounding-box h=1313px while its parent's overflow-hidden 4:3 container is h=554px. `w-full h-full` on the img is not being honoured because the parent's aspectRatio-only inline style doesn't resolve height for the percentage. Visually the image is clipped correctly (554px 4:3 box) but the img element occupies the DOM extent of its intrinsic dimensions. Practical impact: clicking the visible image opens the lightbox correctly (verified). But automated tests that click at the DOM bounding-box center (y=805) hit whatever is in the document flow below y=703 (the badge row). Fix suggestion: wrap the SafeImage in a nested
so it inherits the 4/3 box explicitly, OR add `min-h-0 max-h-full` on the img, OR change parent to explicit `h-[...]` instead of aspectRatio.

action_items: OPTIONAL — Fix the DOM overflow on LotDetailPage main image so h-full is honoured. Not user-visible but improves DOM/visual consistency and enables tests to click at the DOM center.
critical_code_review_comments: iter369 Auto-Bid modal fix is correct: <Dialog open={open && !!lot}> always mounts so Radix Dialog can register open transitions, and the null-guard is now on the inner children only. This resolves the legacy .js/.jsx shadowing symptom cleanly.
MultiItemListingDetailPage.js still has a dead `autoBidModalOpen` useState at line 87 that isn't referenced anywhere. Safe to remove — cognitive-load only, no impact.

LotDetailPage main image container uses `style={{ aspectRatio: '4 / 3' }}` without an explicit height — inner `` computes h to its intrinsic value in some browsers because % height requires resolved parent height. `overflow-hidden` clips the visual, but the DOM extent leaks. Recommended: use `h-[554px]` explicitly (or wrap img in `absolute inset-0`).
